_method: Playwright observation of dashboard.clarity.microsoft.com/api/v2 POST requests with cro-cart-3way=1 filter applied
_notes: All `query` strings are lifted verbatim from observed network calls. Some operations (getSessionMetrics, getInsightsMetrics, getDistributionData) are GENERIC: the dashboard reuses a single operationName but selects different fields per call site. We replicate this by shipping multiple Operation entries with the same operationName but distinct queries, one per metric we need.
_stillToCapture: getRecordings - the recordings-list query from /sessions or /recordings page. Could not be captured in this pass because the recordings page kept redirecting to dashboard. Task 10 implementer should capture this just-in-time by clicking 'Go to recordings' from a dashboard card.

listCustomTagKeys - the tag-key dropdown was populated WITHOUT a new GraphQL call (likely cached from an earlier op or part of getProjectSummary metadata). Task 8 implementer should capture this by inspecting the response of getFilterOptions or getProjectSummary, OR by extending getFilterOptions selection to include `Variables`.
listCustomTagValues - the value combobox population. Same caveat as above; capture during Task 8.

getInsightsMetrics_friction._description: Returns rage clicks, dead clicks, excessive scrolls, quickbacks all in one call
getInsightsMetrics_friction.returnsShape: { rageClicks: FrictionMetric, deadClicks: FrictionMetric, excessiveScrolls: FrictionMetric, quickBacks: FrictionMetric }

getDistributionData_smartEvents.returnsShape: Array<{ item: string, count: number, extraData: any }>

getPerfMetrics.returnsShape: { pageViews, goodViews, poorViews, improveViews, score, lcp, cls, inp }

getFilterOptions._description: Single op that returns filter dropdown options for ALL dimensions. Notably does NOT include Variables (custom tags) in observed selection — extending the selection to include Variables MAY be a path to discover available custom tag keys (untested).

variableShape.filter: string (JSON envelope, even with empty filters needs the date range envelope)

getFilterOptions.returnsShape: Object with arrays for each dimension
